speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you have had increasing pain and swelling in your left knee for the past two months. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if this pain is worse in the morning or after you have been active throughout the day?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text: The pain is severe enough to wake you from sleep, which is concerning. Given your age and the chronic nature of the swelling, have you noticed any stiffness in the joint for more than 30 minutes, or do you have any history of similar joint issues in your family?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe pain and swelling in the left knee. I also have Pain intensifying over 2 months, Painful awakenings during night, No relief with ibuprofen. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pigmented Villonodular Synovitis (PVNS) of the left knee.

The severe pain, night awakenings, lack of response to NSAIDs, and the chronic 2-month swelling in a young male are highly characteristic of this condition. I will order an MRI to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of the synovial involvement.

REQUEST IMAGES: Left_Knee_MRI
REQUEST TEST: Knee_Synovial_Biopsy
